import hashlib, os, tarfile
from pathlib import Path
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
repo = 'ahzs645/tcger-universal-arcface'
revision = '3016a7f6edfdcdb3e9abd6ec1fecc7125b22b7a8'
training_revision = '3016a7f6edfdcdb3e9abd6ec1fecc7125b22b7a8'
token = os.environ['HF_TOKEN']
tooling = Path(hf_hub_download(repo_id=repo, filename='geometry/tooling/9a96e11fb09aa82693eff9b0301e24b1dda9a734/card-geometry-tooling.tar.gz', revision=revision, token=token))
config = Path(hf_hub_download(repo_id=repo, filename='geometry/bakeoffs/9a96e11fb09aa82693eff9b0301e24b1dda9a734/41c110e13eef6c898d31ed9ba7e56bdc449f3651ffb6ad7f103655eac60495cf/yolo11s-pose.json', revision=training_revision, token=token))
preflight = Path(hf_hub_download(repo_id=repo, filename='geometry/preflights/41c110e13eef6c898d31ed9ba7e56bdc449f3651ffb6ad7f103655eac60495cf/8e315f1b5fb18643f97a30fd159b904324e21181ed45c69e6ce20624b53d336a.json', revision=training_revision, token=token))
for path, expected in ((tooling, '7a38b2563458397e378b5d1a9fdbb0e30a39643243f6471d2d3a1932d41c64bb'), (config, 'a3e8601de2a72bf11194087a3b72090ec1914c3f292d1b4ed52c817d24124ebc'), (preflight, '8e315f1b5fb18643f97a30fd159b904324e21181ed45c69e6ce20624b53d336a')):
    actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if actual != expected:
        raise SystemExit(f'pinned input hash mismatch for {path.name}: {actual}')
source = Path('/work/src')
source.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
with tarfile.open(tooling, 'r:gz') as archive:
    archive.extractall(source)
Path('/work/experiment.json').write_bytes(config.read_bytes())
Path('/work/preflight-report.json').write_bytes(preflight.read_bytes())
PY
export TCGER_GEOMETRY_PREFLIGHT_REPORT=/work/preflight-report.json
cd /work/src
python tools/card-geometry/run_card_geometry_hf_job.py --config /work/experiment.json --action train --workdir /work/tcger-card-geometry-yolo11s-pose
python - <<'TCGER_REVIEWED_COMPARISON'

import hashlib, json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
from huggingface_hub import HfApi, get_token, hf_hub_download
root = Path('/work/reviewed-results'); root.mkdir()
inputs = [['geometry/reviewed-label-inputs/41c110e13eef6c898d31ed9ba7e56bdc449f3651ffb6ad7f103655eac60495cf/collect_results.py', '7d5ba2a5ac5621cff79c5f9b13c81ffaab56438dbb9267102a49d65f36aa61a7', 'collect_results.py'], ['geometry/reviewed-label-inputs/41c110e13eef6c898d31ed9ba7e56bdc449f3651ffb6ad7f103655eac60495cf/freeze.json', '41d4564fe60a85aa5a8db34b5eb9519043580b9bd084552c7919672058ae256d', 'freeze.json'], ['geometry/bakeoffs/9a96e11fb09aa82693eff9b0301e24b1dda9a734/41c110e13eef6c898d31ed9ba7e56bdc449f3651ffb6ad7f103655eac60495cf/yolo11s-pose.json', 'a3e8601de2a72bf11194087a3b72090ec1914c3f292d1b4ed52c817d24124ebc', 'yolo11s-pose.json']]
for remote, digest, name in inputs:
    cached = Path(hf_hub_download('ahzs645/tcger-universal-arcface', remote, revision='3016a7f6edfdcdb3e9abd6ec1fecc7125b22b7a8', token=get_token()))
    assert hashlib.sha256(cached.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, remote
    shutil.copy2(cached, root / name)
env = dict(os.environ, TCGER_GEOMETRY_REPOSITORY_ROOT='/work/src')
subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / 'collect_results.py')], check=True, env=env)
HfApi(token=get_token()).upload_folder(repo_id='ahzs645/tcger-universal-arcface', folder_path=str(root),
    path_in_repo='geometry/yolo11s-pose/41c110e13eef6c898d31ed9ba7e56bdc449f3651ffb6ad7f103655eac60495cf/0c78006b4b116bcdc7ebf3fb29c99de48780f6c43441d85d80b2eac67c3960ba' + '/comparison',
    allow_patterns=['comparison.json', 'result-verification.json', 'RESULTS.md'],
    commit_message='Compare reviewed YOLO11s against the frozen successor baseline')
print('Reviewed YOLO11s training, evaluations, and verified baseline comparison complete.')

TCGER_REVIEWED_COMPARISON
